messages:
alex: quick sanity check — ran Sherpa11b int4 vs int8 on the 400-sample GTN smoke slice. int4 wins on token cost (~3.2x cheaper) but shows a quality wobble on priming-heavy prompts. posting quick numbers.
ria: can you drop the basic metrics? like p95 latency, tokens/sec, and the human accept rates?
alex: sure — int8: cost_per_1k_tokens=$0.54, p95=210ms, tokens/sec=320; accept_rate(human)=94%
alex: int4: cost_per_1k_tokens=$0.17, p95=230ms, tokens/sec=850; accept_rate(human)=86%
sam: math check: effective cost_per_accepted = cost / accept_rate -> int8 ≈ $0.57, int4 ≈ $0.20. big win economically even with lower accept rate.
maria: but the failures are clustered on multi-turn priming with long context — pass rate drops to ~74% on the "assistants with persona" sub-slice. that's worrying for product.
alex: agree. avg context length for that sub-slice is ~1200 tokens, and int4 KV-cache eviction looks noisier. small repro attached (see later).
ria: can we route by prefix length? long contexts to int8, short to int4? also consider fallback to int8 on a low-confidence signal.
sam: +1. propose hybrid routing: default int4, route to int8 when (prompt_tokens>800) OR (model_confidence<0.6) OR if prompt matches persona regex.
maria: what's the expected unit economics for that hybrid? even a 20% long-context traffic would still save a lot.
alex: rough calc: baseline traffic 100k requests/day, avg tokens/request 400. Pure int8 cost ≈ $0.54 * (400/1000)*100k ≈ $21,600/day. Pure int4 ≈ $0.17*(400/1000)*100k ≈ $6,800/day. Hybrid(20% int8) ≈ 0.8*6.8k + 0.2*21.6k ≈ $10.96k/day — ~49% savings vs pure int8.
ria: love the calc. operational risk: need canary and monitoring. define alert thresholds: delta_accept_rate > 4% absolute on rolling 1h, or latency p95 > baseline+40ms -> auto-swap to int8.
sam: also instrument prefix-level drift: if sub-slice accept rate falls by >6% for 30m, trigger human review.
alex: I drafted a mini scorecard for GTN (short):
```
- bucketed metrics: short (<=256), mid (257-800), long (>800)
- per-bucket: accept_rate, p95 latency, tokens/sec, cost_per_accepted
- recommendation: default=int4 for short+mid, route long->int8; fallback policy=instant on alert
- rollout: 5% -> 25% -> 60% over 48h with manual gate at 60% if sub-slice drift detected
```
ria: can you attach the 10 worst-regression examples? GTN wants indicative prompts not raw logs.
alex: will anonymize and add 10 short examples plus one failing trace. also running a 1k-sample blind eval to tighten CI.
maria: operational note — make sure KV-cache warmstart for int4 before serving long contexts, we saw a warmup penalty in the lab. add a 5-request warmup policy for >1k token contexts.
sam: deploy-bot: canary toggle?
deploy-bot: canary started: sherpa11b-int4->hybrid-route v0.3; traffic=5%; monitoring hooks: accept_rate, p95, prefix-drift.
ria: thanks — next steps: alex to push anonymized examples + 1k blind eval results; sam to draft routing flag and policy; maria to add warmstart script to ops runbook. aim to present to GTN tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
